latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of data-team-leader-coach.

- Provides coaching for newly-hired or promoted data leaders (Head/VP/Director/Data Platform Lead) through onboarding and strategic decision-making.
- Covers role archetypes (analytics-led, platform-led, ML-led, hybrids) and team composition.
- Guides first 30 days: stakeholder mapping, listening tour, and tech/data stack audit.
- Includes frameworks for prioritization, buy-vs-build decisions, and addressing common organizational failure modes.
- Outlines triggers for use and when the skill should not be engaged.
